ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting <5% of the total visible area, primarily as superficial abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-grey/black pigmentation across the global surface; scattered light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) on the left and right mid-lobes; high-intensity pixel clusters localized at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Open U-shaped depression; vertex angle approximately 140 degrees with shallow bounding-box depth relative to horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary; moderate-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks of 3-10px; pronounced irregularities and erosion observed at distal terminal points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal extremities of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the ventral surface, most prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Uneven erosion and jagged topography at the distal lobe tips; extensive linear rake mark scarring across the mid-lobar regions.
